svg.title: A mountain pass and a surface reaction transition state
svg.desc: Qualitative elevation cuts and a schematic Tafel recombination step, not measured topography or a calculated reaction path. Photograph by Michael Rogers, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Rogers_pass.jpg, CC BY-SA 3.0, unmodified. Diagram and composite distributed under CC BY-SA 3.0.
